utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can be there at 9:30 on Saturday and help with the tools and sign-in sheet.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Uli. Please set up the tools and sign-in sheet on the front porch, and keep it simple so we can get started on time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Oren. See you at the front porch Saturday at 10 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, Saturday at 10 a.m. at the front porch. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, I’ll be at the front porch Saturday to help with the repair drive. I can do hands-on tasks most, so tell me what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik, but the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll send the updated details and could still use a few extra hands for sorting and carrying.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that’s right, Tess. Saturday at the front porch, and I’d really appreciate any neighbors you send my way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Sam — I’ll keep passing it along and see who else can lend a hand on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Rosa, the repair drive is this Saturday at the front porch, and we’re still rounding up a few helping hands. If you can make it, that would really help us out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for the update, Tess. It’s actually moved to Sunday at the community center now, and I’ll help keep the details simple so folks know where to go.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Sam. Can you make it to the front porch this Saturday for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can be there this Saturday at the front porch and help out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, I’m in. I’ll be at the front porch Saturday to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik. I’ll be there at the front porch Saturday at 10 a.m. too.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
